title: bind_interaction inputSchema
description: Argument shape for bind_interaction (composition profile, ADR-0030). Adds or replaces (by interaction id) one declarative event→action binding in a composition document. The standard-level target is a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId). The reference implementation authors compositions through a draft lifecycle; its optimistic-concurrency draft spelling (draftId + generation) is admitted as x-honua-reference-shape, consistent with ADR-0029's admission of reference spellings. Validation gate: the interaction's on.ref and do.ref must resolve to components declared in the target document, and the per-(on.ref, on.event) fan-out cap applies (recommended 8). See docs/adr/0030-declarative-interactions-and-layout.md and common/interactions.schema.json.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

interaction.description: The binding to add or replace. Replacement matches on interaction.id.
